critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3778 lines — the extraction recommendation from prior iterations (split rooms/demo/products/library/shortlist into modules) remains open. Sprint 6 added ~170 lines (shortlist + library endpoints).
Shortlist endpoints use ObjectId(project_id) inside try/except but the generic 'except Exception -> 400' also swallows unrelated DB errors as bad-request. Acceptable but noisy in logs.
GLOBAL_LIBRARY_SEED (server.py L3685-3722) is a Python constant — fine for now, but if this becomes real per-user library metadata, move to Mongo collection.

library_my aggregates from every project synchronously per user; for a user with 100s of projects each with many uploaded_files this becomes an in-memory O(N*M). Add pagination or an index-backed query when scaling.
shortlist_items schema is denormalised inside the project doc via $push — no index, no per-item update endpoint yet. Acceptable for Sprint 6 scope.
